subject: Event schedule update
text: Hi! Just got your note about the tent size, and I wanted to follow up with the current schedule since a few things shifted after our last chat. The doors open at 5:30 instead of 5, and the welcome toast will begin at 6:15 in the east courtyard. We still expect about ninety guests, so your team can enter from the side gate. Please confirm if the updated timing works, especially around catering and lighting.
